text:
Hi guys 👋🏿
To anyone who opened a bank account with Bank Leumi while on a B1 visa; what were the requirements? I contacted them and was told I need two IDs and a passport photo, but online there’s a much longer list of documents.

 I just want to avoid going there unprepared and being told I need additional paperwork. I’d really appreciate hearing from people who’ve gone through the process; what exactly were you required to bring?
